question: In the realm of cinema, documentaries are characterised by: (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (14/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: focusing on fictional suspense
fabricated storylines
presenting real-world content for learning or leisure
aiming to communicate about mythological characters
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is presenting real-world content for learning or leisure

Explanation:
Documentaries are a genre of cinema that focuses on real-world subjects, events, and people. Their primary characteristic is the presentation of factual content for the purpose of education, information, or entertainment. Unlike fictional films, documentaries do not rely on fabricated storylines or mythological characters; instead, they use actual footage, interviews, and archival material to depict reality. This genre aims to provide knowledge and insight into various topics such as history, science, society, and culture. Documentaries can be both engaging and informative, making them a valuable medium for learning and reflection.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Primary focus of documentary films → Real-world content
☛ Purpose of documentaries → Educate and inform
☛ Common techniques used → Interviews and archival footage
☛ Difference between documentary and fiction → Documentary is factual, fiction is imaginative
☛ Example of a well-known documentary → "Super Size Me"

question: Which of the following was among the first financial institutions in India to receive an 'in principle' approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to set up a bank in the private sector?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (18/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: IndusInd Bank Limited
Axis Bank Limited
Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited
HDFC Limited
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is HDFC Limited

Explanation:
HDFC (Housing Development Finance Corporation) Limited was among the first financial institutions in India to receive an 'in principle' approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to set up a bank in the private sector. This approval was granted under the RBI's policy for establishing private sector banks in the 1990s. HDFC established HDFC Bank in 1994, which today is one of India's leading private sector banks. Other options include IndusInd Bank, Axis Bank, and Kotak Mahindra Bank, which are also private sector banks, but HDFC was the first institution to receive this in-principle approval.

☛ Year of establishment of HDFC Bank → 1994

HDFC (हाउसिंग डेवलपमेंट फाइनेंस कॉरपोरेशन) लिमिटेड को RBI से निजी क्षेत्र में बैंक स्थापित करने की 'सैद्धांतिक' मंजूरी प्राप्त करने वाला पहला वित्तीय संस्थान होने का गौरव प्राप्त है। यह मंजूरी 1990 के दशक में निजी क्षेत्र के बैंकों की स्थापना के लिए RBI की नीति के तहत दी गई थी। HDFC ने 1994 में HDFC बैंक की स्थापना की, जो आज भारत के अग्रणी निजी क्षेत्र के बैंकों में से एक है। अन्य विकल्पों में इंडसइंड बैंक, एक्सिस बैंक और कोटक महिंद्रा बैंक भी निजी क्षेत्र के बैंक हैं, लेकिन HDFC पहला संस्थान था जिसे यह सैद्धांतिक मंजूरी मिली थी।

question: Which of the following is the official language of the state of Manipur?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (18/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Khasi
Mizo
Bodo
Meitei
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Meitei

Explanation:
The official language of the state of Manipur is Meitei (also known as Manipuri). It belongs to the Tibeto-Burman language family and is spoken by the majority of the state's population. Meitei was included in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution in 1992. It is the primary language used in education, administration, and media in Manipur. Among the other options, Khasi is associated with Meghalaya, Mizo with Mizoram, and Bodo with Assam. Meitei is written in the Meitei script, though historically the Meitei Mayek script was used.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Official language of Manipur → Meitei (Manipuri)
☛ Language family of Meitei → Tibeto-Burman
☛ Year Meitei added to Eighth Schedule → 1992
☛ Script of Meitei language → Meitei (also written in Bengali script)
☛ Khasi language is associated with which state → Meghalaya
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी मणिपुर राज्य की आधिकारिक भाषा है? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (18/08/2025) Shift 1)
options_hi: खासी
मिज़ो
बोडो
मेइतेई
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है मेइतेई

Explanation:
मणिपुर राज्य की आधिकारिक भाषा मेइतेई (मणिपुरी) है। यह तिब्बती-बर्मी भाषा परिवार से संबंधित है और राज्य की अधिकांश जनसंख्या द्वारा बोली जाती है। मेइतेई भाषा को 1992 में भारतीय संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में शामिल किया गया था। यह मणिपुर में शिक्षा, प्रशासन और मीडिया की प्रमुख भाषा है। अन्य विकल्पों में खासी मेघालय, मिज़ो मिज़ोरम और बोडो असम से संबंधित हैं। मेइतेई लिपि में लिखी जाती है, हालांकि पहले मेइतेई मायेक लिपि का प्रयोग होता था।

question: Who among the following is regarded as the father of modern Hindi literature and theatre?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (18/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Bharatendu Harishchandra
Jaishankar Prasad
Mahavir Prasad Dwivedi
Premchand
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bharatendu Harishchandra

Explanation:
Bharatendu Harishchandra is regarded as the father of modern Hindi literature and theatre. He developed Hindi prose and wrote plays like 'Bharat Durdasha' and 'Andher Nagari'. His works focused on social and political awareness. He introduced realism and nationalism in Hindi literature. His period is called 'Bharatendu Yug'. Other options are also significant, but Bharatendu holds this honor.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When did Bharatendu Harishchandra die? → 1885 AD
☛ Play written by Bharatendu → 'Andher Nagari'
☛ What is the period of 'Bharatendu Yug'? → 1868-1885 AD
☛ Famous plays by Bharatendu → 'Bharat Durdasha', 'Neel Devi'
☛ Who is the father of modern Hindi theatre? → Bharatendu Harishchandra

Explanation:
भारतेन्दु हरिश्चंद्र को आधुनिक हिंदी साहित्य और रंगमंच का जनक माना जाता है। उन्होंने हिंदी गद्य को विकसित किया और नाटक लिखे, जैसे 'भारत दुर्दशा' और 'अंधेर नगरी'। उनकी रचनाओं में सामाजिक और राजनीतिक चेतना मुख्य थी। वे हिंदी साहित्य में यथार्थवाद और राष्ट्रीयता लेकर आए। उनके योगदान के कारण उनके समय को 'भारतेन्दु युग' कहते हैं। अन्य विकल्प भी महत्वपूर्ण हैं, लेकिन भारतेन्दु को ही यह गौरव प्राप्त है।

question: India achieved a historic feat by winning the presidency of which international organisation for the first time through the voting process? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (18/08/2025) Shift 2)
options: United Nations Development Program (UNDP)
International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS)
World Health Organization (WHO)
International Labour Organization (ILO)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS)

Explanation:
India achieved a historic feat by winning the presidency of the International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS) for the first time through the voting process. This organization is a leading body in the field of administrative sciences, established in 1930. India's administrative reforms and contributions to global governance were recognized. IIAS promotes administrative studies, policy-making, and governance improvements. This achievement is a matter of pride for India as it marks the first time an Indian was elected to this position through voting.

question: Which company became the first in India to develop steel pipes for hydrogen transportation? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (18/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: Hindalco Industries

SAIL

Tata Steel has also played a key role in green hydrogen production and usage.

जिंदल स्टील एंड पावर
टाटा स्टील
सेल

question: Which of the following architectural styles is predominantly associated with the Gateway of India in Mumbai?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (19/08/2025) Shift 1)
options: Indo-Saracenic
Art Deco
Bauhaus
Victorian Gothic
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Indo-Saracenic

Explanation:
The Gateway of India is a prominent monument located in Mumbai, built during British rule in 1911. Its architecture is predominantly based on the Indo-Saracenic style, which blends Indian, Islamic, and British elements. This style features domes, minarets, and intricate carvings. The Gateway was designed by architect George Wittet and its construction was completed in 1924. The monument is made of basalt stone and stands about 26 meters tall. While Art Deco and Victorian Gothic styles are found in other Mumbai buildings, the Gateway of India is a classic example of Indo-Saracenic architecture.

question: Sanskrit language is mainly used for creating: (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (19/08/2025) Shift 2)

question: Which convention, ratified in 1998, seeks to protect the environment and human health by encouraging shared responsibility and cooperation in the global trade of pesticides and hazardous chemicals? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (20/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: Paris Agreement
Basel Convention
Rotterdam Convention
Stockholm Convention
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rotterdam Convention

Explanation:
The Rotterdam Convention, ratified in 1998, is a multilateral environmental agreement that promotes shared responsibility and cooperation in the international trade of pesticides and hazardous chemicals. Its goal is to protect human health and the environment from potential harm. The convention is based on the Prior Informed Consent (PIC) procedure, which requires exporters to obtain the consent of importing countries before shipping certain chemicals. This empowers developing nations to make informed decisions about hazardous imports. The convention lists approximately 50 chemicals and is also known as the 'PIC Convention'. It operates under the auspices of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). The Rotterdam Convention complements the Basel and Stockholm Conventions in the sound management of chemicals.

☛ Under which two organizations does the Rotterdam Convention operate? → UNEP and FAO

☛ What is the alternative name of the Rotterdam Convention? → PIC Convention

question: What is the main feature of classical Indian drama? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (20/08/2025) Shift 3)

Not using makeup
Only Dance
Inclusion of sentiments
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Inclusion of sentiments

Explanation:

According to Bharata's Natyashastra, drama incorporates navarasas (nine sentiments): shringara, veera, karuna, adbhuta, hasya, bhayanaka, bibhatsa, raudra, and shanta. These rasas evoke emotions in the audience. Classical drama uses stage, acting, and dialogue to express these sentiments. It was not limited to comedy or dance; makeup and costumes were also used. Thus, the inclusion of rasas is the core element of classical Indian drama.

question: Each modern industrialised country, including India, has a National Metrology Institute (NMI). What is the main role of an NMI?  (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (21/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: To maintain standards of measurements
To monitor weather conditions
To regulate internet access in the country
To conduct medical research
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is To maintain standards of measurements

Explanation:
The primary role of a National Metrology Institute (NMI) is to establish, maintain, and disseminate national measurement standards, ensuring traceability to international standards. This guarantees uniformity and accuracy in measurements across the country, which is crucial for trade, industry, science, and technology. In India, the National Physical Laboratory (NPL) under CSIR acts as the NMI, maintaining SI units and providing calibration services. NMIs are not involved in weather monitoring, internet regulation, or medical research. They form part of a global network under the BIPM that ensures measurement consistency worldwide.

राष्ट्रीय मेट्रोलॉजी संस्थान (एनएमआई) का मुख्य कार्य मापन के राष्ट्रीय मानकों को स्थापित करना, बनाए रखना और अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर उनकी तुलना सुनिश्चित करना है। यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि देश में सभी मापन उपकरण एक समान और विश्वसनीय हों, जो व्यापार, उद्योग, विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी के लिए आवश्यक है। भारत में भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (BIS) के तहत राष्ट्रीय भौतिक प्रयोगशाला (NPL) एनएमआई के रूप में कार्य करती है। यह SI इकाइयों के मानकों को बनाए रखती है और अंशांकन सेवाएं प्रदान करती है। एनएमआई की भूमिका मौसम, इंटरनेट या चिकित्सा अनुसंधान से संबंधित नहीं है।

question: Which of the following films is considered the first Indian sound (talkie) film, marking the beginning of Bollywood? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (21/08/2025) Shift 3)
options: Sholay
Raja Harishchandra
Alam Ara
Mughal-e-Azam
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Alam Ara

Explanation:
The first Indian sound film (talkie) was Alam Ara, released on March 14, 1931. It was directed by Ardeshir Irani and produced by Imperial Studios. This film was the first Indian film with dialogues and songs, marking the beginning of the sound era in Indian cinema. The lead roles were played by Master Vithal and Zubeida. 'Alam Ara' is considered the birth of Bollywood, though the term 'Bollywood' was coined later. Prior to this, Raja Harishchandra (1913) was a silent film, while Sholay and Mughal-e-Azam are later iconic films.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी फिल्म पहली भारतीय ध्वनि (टॉकी) फिल्म मानी जाती है, जिसने बॉलीवुड की शुरुआत की? (RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I (21/08/2025) Shift 3)
options_hi: शोले
राजा हरिश्चंद्र
आलम आरा
मुगल-ए-आजम
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है आलम आरा

Explanation:
भारत की पहली सवाक् (टॉकी) फिल्म आलम आरा थी, जो 14 मार्च 1931 को प्रदर्शित हुई थी। इसका निर्देशन अर्देशिर ईरानी ने किया था और इसका निर्माण इंपीरियल स्टूडियो ने किया था। यह फिल्म पूरी तरह से संवाद और गीतों वाली पहली भारतीय फिल्म थी, जिसने भारतीय सिनेमा में ध्वनि के युग की शुरुआत की। इस फिल्म में मास्टर विट्ठल और जुबैदा मुख्य भूमिकाओं में थे। 'आलम आरा' के साथ ही बॉलीवुड का जन्म हुआ, हालांकि 'बॉलीवुड' शब्द बाद में प्रचलित हुआ। इससे पहले राजा हरिश्चंद्र (1913) मूक फिल्म थी, जबकि शोले और मुगल-ए-आज़म बाद की कालजयी फिल्में हैं।
